# US equity/options market full-day closures (NYSE calendar), one ISO date
# per line. Read ONLY by the deploy freeze gate in .github/workflows/deploy.yml.
#
# Why a static file and not Alpaca's clock. The bot itself is already
# holiday-aware the right way - it asks the broker (`get_clock().is_open`)
# before calling the model, and that is authoritative. The deploy gate cannot:
# it runs in CI with no broker credentials, and a gate that must fail closed
# should not depend on a network call that can time out. So this list exists
# for CI alone. It is not a second source of truth for the bot; nothing under
# bot/ reads it, and nothing under bot/ should.
#
# Failure direction. An unlisted date is treated as a TRADING day, which keeps
# the freeze on. Over-blocking costs a wait until 15:15 CT; under-blocking
# deploys trading code into a live session. When a date is uncertain, leave it
# out. The gate warns when today's year is past the end of this list.
#
# Weekends are not listed - the gate already skips Saturday and Sunday.
#
# Early closes (13:00 ET: the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Eve when
# it falls on a weekday) are deliberately NOT listed. Cycles stop at the close
# on those days, but the 14:50 CT flatten and 15:05 CT review still run on the
# normal schedule, so the freeze has to cover its usual window anyway.
#
# NYSE Rule 7.2: a holiday falling on Saturday closes the preceding Friday,
# UNLESS that Friday is the last trading day of the year. Hence 2027-12-31 is
# absent below - the exchange is open - and Jan 1 2028 (a Saturday) is not
# observed on either side.
#
# tests/test_market_holidays.py checks the format, ordering and coverage.

# --- 2026 ---
2026-01-01  # New Year's Day
2026-01-19  # Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
2026-02-16  # Washington's Birthday
2026-04-03  # Good Friday
2026-05-25  # Memorial Day
2026-06-19  # Juneteenth
2026-07-03  # Independence Day (observed; Jul 4 is a Saturday)
2026-09-07  # Labor Day
2026-11-26  # Thanksgiving Day
2026-12-25  # Christmas Day

# --- 2027 ---
2027-01-01  # New Year's Day
2027-01-18  # Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
2027-02-15  # Washington's Birthday
2027-03-26  # Good Friday
2027-05-31  # Memorial Day
2027-06-18  # Juneteenth (observed; Jun 19 is a Saturday)
2027-07-05  # Independence Day (observed; Jul 4 is a Sunday)
2027-09-06  # Labor Day
2027-11-25  # Thanksgiving Day
2027-12-24  # Christmas Day (observed; Dec 25 is a Saturday)

# --- 2028 ---
2028-01-17  # Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
2028-02-21  # Washington's Birthday
2028-04-14  # Good Friday
2028-05-29  # Memorial Day
2028-06-19  # Juneteenth
2028-07-04  # Independence Day
2028-09-04  # Labor Day
2028-11-23  # Thanksgiving Day
2028-12-25  # Christmas Day
